provenance.writtenFor: DROBON AEGIS DAST cumulative master pump, iteration 2 (2026-10-19)
provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence

purpose: A Basic challenge on a plaintext HTTP response transmits reusable credentials in base64 (new rule DPK-DAST-096).

groundTruth.rationale: The observation is http and the server offers the Basic scheme, so credentials will cross the network without transport encryption.

limitations: Observation mode: no request was sent and no credential was supplied or stored.
A challenge proves the scheme is offered, not that any user answers it.
